subject.title: fix(codex): user-home Codex harness config no longer requires supervision to be enabled

question: Should a declared `plugins.entries.codex.config` block remain sufficient to activate the bundled Codex plugin independently of `supervision.enabled`?
rationale: This is an upgrade-sensitive bundled-plugin activation default: it determines whether existing operator configuration is honored, so the intended activation contract needs maintainer confirmation after checking the shared resolver and Codex runtime boundary.

options.title: Confirm config-driven activation
options.body: Accept the live Codex config block as the plugin-side default while preserving all explicit revocation paths; this matches the proposed regression coverage.

options.title: Keep supervision as the gate
options.body: Reject the behavior change if the product contract intentionally requires explicit Codex enablement whenever supervision is off.

recommendation.title: Confirm config-driven activation
recommendation.body: Accept the live Codex config block as the plugin-side default while preserving all explicit revocation paths; this matches the proposed regression coverage.
